VIA HAND DELIVERY AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

The Honorable Scott S.  Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N .E. 
Washington, D.C.  20543 

Re:  Monasky v. Taglieri, No.  18-935 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

I  am  counsel  of  record  for  petlt10ner  in  the  above-referenced  case.  Petitioner  hereby 
respectfully requests a twenty-one-day extension of time, to  and including August  15, 2019, 
to file  her opening brief and the joint appendix.  Counsel for respondent has consented to  this 
extension. 

In tum, petitioner has consented to  a twenty-one-day extension of time for respondent to  file 
his brief, to and including October 7, 2019. 

Thank you for  your consideration. 

Very truly yours, 

Amir C.  Tayrani 

cc:  Andrew J.  Pincus, Esq. 
Counsel for Respondent
